streamloots.header: Connect {LINK} to receive cards redemptions, packs purchases and gifts, reactions and emotes
streamloots.instructions: On your Streamloots dashboard, open "Alerts & Widgets", copy your alerts URL and paste it below

error_messages.INVALID_URL:
Invalid URL.
It should look like https://widgets.streamloots.com/alerts/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
error_messages.CONNECT_FAILED:
Connection to Streamloots failed.
Make sure the alerts URL is valid.
